params.name: offset
params.description: An integer that designates the offset at which to begin returning results. Defaults to 0.

params.name: include
params.description: Request that the response include the total count by specifying `include=["total_count"]`.

params.name: date_created
params.description: Filter by date created. Accepted formats are ISO-8601 date or datetime, e.g. `{ "gt": "2012-01-01", "lt": "2012-01-31T12:34:56Z" }` where `gt` is >, `lt` is <, `gte` is ≥, and `lte` is ≤.

params.name: scanned
params.description: Filter list of responses to only include QR codes with at least one scan event.

items.docs: Returns a list of your QR codes. The QR codes are returned sorted by scan date, with the most recently scanned QR codes appearing first.
